Power of the Trio

This puzzle was part of a collaboration prompt ran by Mnasti2 on Skunkworks. The idea was to set a duality/ambiguity puzzle with an assigned partner. The catch was nobody knew who they were assigned with. We would have opportunities to try to figure out who our partners were. We would message each other privately via a bot. I was fortunate enough to be assigned TVDK. TVDK was a great teammate who brought good insight, inspiration, and kept good communication.

TVDK and I hope you enjoy the puzzle.

Would like to thank TVDK for her teamwork. Would also like to thank Mnasti2 for putting on the prompt. It was a fun event. Be sure to check out both their LMD pages where a link will be posted near the bottom.

Rules:

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

DUALITY:

-All outside clues act as a Numbered Rooms clue and a Skyscraper clue.

-NUMBERED ROOMS: A clue outside the grid indicates the digit which has to be placed in the Nth cell from that direction, where N is the digit placed in the first cell from the clue.

-SKYSCRAPER: Each digit represents a building height. A clue outside the grid gives the number of buildings visible from that direction, where taller buildings block the view of shorter ones behind them.

AMBIGUITY:

-Each grey line is either an Index Line or Region Sum Line. The line type must be determined by the solver.

-INDEX LINES: The digit in the Nth cell of an Index Line, counting from one of the endpoints, gives the position on that line where the digit N appears. The start of the Index Line must be determined by the solver.

-REGION SUM LINES: Segments in each region along a Region Sum Line must sum to the same total. Regions are divided by box borders.
